name: ss-keel-otel
description: OpenTelemetry instrumentation — traces, metrics, and automatic Fiber HTTP spans via OTLP

steps.description: Logical service name reported in all telemetry signals.
Service version reported as a resource attribute.
OTLP collector endpoint. Read directly by the SDK exporter.
OTLP transport protocol: http/protobuf (default) or grpc.
Trace sampler: always_on, always_off, parentbased_always_on, traceidratio, parentbased_traceidratio.
Sampler argument — ratio value (0.0–1.0) for traceidratio samplers.
Enable OpenTelemetry. Set to true in environments where you want telemetry data.
Logical service name. Appears in traces, metrics, and dashboards.
Service version (e.g. 1.4.2). Reported as a resource attribute.
Deployment environment. Shown in traces and dashboards (e.g. production, staging).
OTLP collector endpoint. Point to your OTel Collector, Grafana Alloy, or any OTLP-compatible receiver.
Trace sampler strategy. Use traceidratio with OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG for production rate control.
Sampler argument for ratio-based samplers (0.0–1.0). Example: 0.1 samples 10% of traces.

steps.message:
OpenTelemetry is ready. Set OTEL_ENABLED=true and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to start sending telemetry.

For manual spans in your services:
  ctx, span := app.Tracer().Start(c.UserContext(), "operation-name")
  defer span.End()

See: docs.keel-go.dev/addons/ss-keel-otel
